E01.question: What ideas did team IS1009 discuss for helping users find a lost remote control?
E01.answer: Team IS1009 discussed having the remote beep when someone claps to help locate it, and A proposed using a light sensor to signal when the remote is in a dark spot. Later, C proposed an automatic light on the remote when the TV is on to aid in locating it. D suggested the remote should beep when someone claps to help locate it because people often lose them.
